description: Read an explicitly selected local file, create an assignment-scoped private upload session using expectedVersion and purpose (DELIVERABLE or ISSUE_EVIDENCE), PUT bytes to the server-issued signed URL without the API key, then complete it. Use only a file the human selected; never pass a URL or base64. The result stays private to this assignment. Requires confirm:true and a stable idempotencyKey.

confirm.description: Required confirmation: call only after the human explicitly approved this action.

filePath.description: Absolute local path to a selected private proof file.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable UUID for this command. Reuse the same UUID if its outcome is unknown.
